inputKind: a Vector of one or more readings, each an exact number (possibly zero, negative or fractional) or NIL for a missing reading; at least one reading is present

tasks.prompt: Leave the mean of the readings that are present.
tasks.reference: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P 0 [ ADD ] FOLD P LENGTH DIV

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector as long as the input in which each missing reading is replaced by the nearest present reading before it; missing readings before the first present one take the first present reading.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN

tasks.prompt: Leave the number of runs of consecutive missing readings (a run is one or more missing readings in a row).
tasks.reference: [ NIL? ] MAP 'B' BIND B FALSE 1 COLLECT B -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND [ ] FILTER LENGTH

tasks.prompt: Leave the length of the longest run of consecutive missing readings (0 when no reading is missing).
tasks.reference: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 E SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector, one shorter than the input, of each reading divided by the reading just before it, in order; where either reading is missing, that element is NIL.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector as long as the input with each present reading divided by the largest present reading; missing readings stay NIL.
tasks.reference: 'V' BIND V V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
